question: Which ministry oversees Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Launched in February 2024?

options.text: Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of New & Renewable Energy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana** was launched in **February 2024** by the Government of India to promote the use of **solar energy** in households.
 
• The scheme is aimed at encouraging **renewable energy adoption** by providing free electricity to households through **solar installations**.
 
• The **Ministry of New & Renewable Energy (MNRE)** is responsible for formulating policies and overseeing the implementation of the scheme.
